title: A Flexible Recommendation System for Individuals and Groups
abstract: arXiv:2609.27998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group recommender systems typically rely on either aggregating individual preferences or treating groups as distinct meta-users. However, these methods often suffer from static aggregation strategies or data sparsity issues within group histories. This paper introduces a novel approach, that relies on a GNN-based architecture to learn a dual representation of each user's preferences, capturing their behavior as an independent individual from one side and as a member of a collective from the other side. By performing a differential analysis of these individual and group-oriented preferences, our system then determines the behavioral profile of each user when joining a group. Finally, specific preference aggregation strategies are defined to cope with the behavioral profiles of the users composing a group. translated_title: 一种面向个人与群体的灵活推荐系统
translated_abstract: 群体推荐系统通常依赖于聚合个人偏好，或将群体视为独立的元用户。然而，这些方法往往存在聚合策略静态化或群体历史数据稀疏的问题。本文提出了一种新颖的方法，该方法基于图神经网络（GNN）架构来学习每个用户偏好的双重表示：一方面捕捉其作为独立个体的行为，另一方面捕捉其作为集体成员的行为。通过对这些个人偏好与面向群体的偏好进行差异分析，我们的系统能够确定每个用户加入群体时的行为特征。最后，系统定义了特定的偏好聚合策略，以应对组成群体的用户的各种行为特征。因此，该系统能够同样精准地向个人和任意群体提供推荐。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于图神经网络的双重偏好表示方法，通过差异分析确定用户加入群体后的行为特征，并采用针对性的偏好聚合策略，实现对个人和任意群体同样精准的推荐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a GNN-based dual representation of user preferences, which determines each user's behavioral profile within groups through differential analysis and applies tailored preference aggregation strategies to deliver equally precise recommendations for both individuals and arbitrary groups.
